description: List models of one manufacturer, best-documented first, at most 8 per call and no paging (total_matches shows the size). Narrow with category or ship_area, or use search_equipment_models with a designation to reach a specific model.

category.description: Category name from list_categories, e.g. 'Radar & ECDIS'.
category.title: Category

limit.description: Maximum number of results; values above 8 are capped at 8.
limit.title: Limit

ship_area.description: Ship area slug from list_ship_areas: engine_room, deck, electrical, navigation, safety, cargo, hvac.
ship_area.title: Ship Area

name: find_by_manufacturer
title: Models of one manufacturer
